concerns.text: The constitution NON-NEGOTIABLY requires a pinned requirements.txt (or pyproject.toml) at code/, yet the tasks explicitly reject dependency pinning ('Rejected scaffolding tasks (directory creation, requirements.txt, lint config...) are absorbed: the platform supplies packages'). No task creates or maintains a pinned dependency file, so this plan element has no covering task.

Plan Phase 4 task 'Generate and record artifact hashes in state/ map' (constitution Principle V) has no corresponding task. No task records content hashes or updates state/projects/PROJ-753...yaml artifact_hashes/updated_at. Similarly the Phase 0 task 'Checksum raw data and record in state/ map' (Principle III) is only partially covered by T001's SHA-256 in data/metadata.json — no task writes to the state map.

Plan Phase 0 task 'Run Reference-Validator Agent on all citations (Constitution Principle II)' has no corresponding task; nothing in the task list produces citation-verification evidence, yet T001/T006/T010 introduce release-paper citations (photometric systems, cross-calibration) that the plan's gate requires to be validated.

T004 implements only simulation_results.schema.yaml (run_id,dipole_amp,quadrupole_amp). The contract simulation_output.schema.yaml (requiring a per-iteration seed field 'always 42') is implemented by no task — an orphaned contract with no covering task. Either a task must implement it or the contract must be retired.

SC-001 requires the FRACTION of supernovae mapped to the HEALPix grid measured against total valid supernovae. T003/T007 only report n_supernovae_used; no task computes or records the mapping fraction, so the success criterion has no measured artifact.

T006 (systematics quantification, cross_calibration/measurement_protocol metadata sections) traces to no FR, SC, or plan element — the plan's 'Violations Addressed' list explicitly removed unbacked work, yet T006 introduces plan-unauthorized scope. It needs a plan-level anchor or removal.

Plan states the mask uses 'the official Pantheon+ selection function' but T003 defines mask = 'pixels with count > 0'. No task covers the plan's selection-function mask element; the discrepancy is unreconciled and directly affects the MASTER correction.
